title: GTA 6 Has Iguanas 🦎
caption:
GTA 6 has iguanas, and Rockstar's own caption says so.
In real Florida, the weather service once forecast falling iguanas.
Would you brake for an iguana in GTA 6? Yes or no?
youtube_description:
GTA 6 has iguanas. On Rockstar's Only in Leonida page, one screenshot from the Leonida Keys is captioned, in Rockstar's own words: "An iguana walks in front of a mobility scooter in the Leonida Keys as people pass by in the background." The iguana is right there on the asphalt, bottom left, while a woman rides past on a blue mobility scooter.

Just a cute background detail? In real Florida, green iguanas are not native and are considered an invasive species, says the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC). On January 21, 2020, the National Weather Service in Miami posted: "This isn't something we usually forecast, but don't be surprised if you see Iguanas falling from the trees tonight as lows drop into the 30s and 40s." And last winter, during a cold snap on February 1 and 2, 2026, people brought 5,195 cold-stunned green iguanas to FWC drop-off sites (Sunrise 3,882, Tequesta 1,075, Marathon 215, Fort Myers 23).

Would you brake for an iguana in GTA 6? Yes or no?

Sources (read Nov 25, 2026):
- Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI: Only in Leonida (Leonida Keys screenshot and its caption): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida
- The screenshot itself (Rockstar Games): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/_next/static/media/Leonida_Keys_02.0~ptk-53gl0lq.jpg
- Rockstar Games, GTA VI Launch Trailer, Oct 15, 2026 (background plate): https://x.com/RockstarGames/status/2110717537964953810
- Rockstar Games, GTA VI Trailer 1, Dec 4, 2023 (background plate): https://x.com/RockstarGames/status/1732149328779571313
- FWC, Green iguana profile ("not native to Florida", "invasive species", Prohibited species list since April 29, 2021): https://myfwc.com/wildlifehabitats/profiles/reptiles/lizards/green-iguana/
- NWS Miami on X, Jan 21, 2020 (falling iguanas): https://x.com/NWSMiami/status/1219691736412246016
- NWS Miami on X, Jan 22, 2020 (Miami low of 30): https://x.com/NWSMiami/status/1219975697390698496
- FWC news release, Feb 4, 2026, "Over 5,000 invasive green iguanas removed from Florida's ecosystems" (Executive Order 26-03): https://myfwc.com/news/all-news/green-iguanas-removed/
- Grand Theft Auto VI, out November 19, 2026: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

Fine print: the REAL FLORIDA half of this Short is about the real world, not the game. We don't claim that iguanas fall, freeze or get hit by cars in GTA 6, or that Leonida is Florida; Rockstar's caption only says "iguana". The OUR ID card compares the in-game iguana with FWC's description of a green iguana (spikes down the neck and back, throat fan, dark rings on the tail). The NWS post is re-created as a tile. Not all 5,195 iguanas were killed; FWC says some went to permit holders.
